newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $993 mln for Wed. Feb 12.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $993 mln for Wed. Feb 12.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales for Wednesday are expected to total $993 million in 23 offerings, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $125 million in seven sales. The largest is a $70 million Knox County, Tenn., deal at 1000 EST.
Negotiated sales total $868 million in 16 offerings. The largest is a $264 million Harris County Health Facilities Authority, issued through Smith Barney Inc.

A total of $57 million of deals are on Reuter's day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds Wednesday depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
